scope: packaging only: freeze the gidi-en-student-v2 seed-1 INT8 encoder (type + target) with its tokenizer into one bundle that declares the whole-word target snap. No training, no seed change, no architecture, tokenizer or vocabulary change, no threshold change. models/gidi-en-v1 and models/gidi-en-v2 are not modified.
architecture: gidi-en-student-v2 seed 1: roberta-base-derived 4x768 encoder (roberta-base layers 2,5,8,11, FFN 2048, 34 position rows, vocabulary pruned to 9,000 byte-level BPE tokens, max_length 32), 40 epochs on silver labels (silver-train + labels-seed + consistent slang notes, 2,355 notes), type head (8 classes) + target BIO head, ONNX INT8 (dynamic, QInt8 weights). No value head and no value parser.

seed_selection.rule: seed 1, the only candidate trained for gidi-en-student-v2 (one seed, last epoch, no checkpoint or seed selection; see experiments/gidi-en-student-v2/protocol.json).

label_provenance: silver-claude-clef: there are no human labels for English. Every score is agreement with Claude, Gemini and Clef labels, not ground truth.
target_snap_rule: the decoded first target span is extended outward to whole words (maximal non-whitespace runs, edge punctuation of the extension trimmed), exactly gidi.inference.decode.snap_to_words; it is a post-processing step outside the ONNX graph.
evaluation_sets_report_only: test (primary, secondary), dev, datasets/probe-en-slang and datasets/probe-en-genz are used only to report quality. Numbers: experiments/gidi-en-student-v2/report.md.
acceptance_gate: bundle reproducible (freeze_en_bundle --check byte-identical); every bundle file matches manifest.json
INT8 model is the ONNX that experiments/gidi-en-student-v2/results.json scored
release verify passes: hashes, runtime config, INT8 and FP32 smoke predictions
on_gate_failure: stop and report the blocker; no retraining, no seed change
